This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="The New Trooper" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Hair|fur]]-covered bodies, being [[Color|brown]] and tan in coloration, with some lighter white hair growing from their faces. Members of this species bore [[canine]]-like traits, with elongated snouts and large [[Nose|noses]], as well as long, wide, pointed [[Ear|ears]].<ref name="The New Trooper" />

==Species in the galaxy==
One [[Unidentified antiques vendor|member]] of this species was a resident aboard the [[supertanker fuel depot]] known as the ''[[Colossus]]''<ref name="The New Trooper" /> by [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' establishes that the events of [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|''Star Wars Resistance'' Season One]], which includes this episode, takes place in [[34 ABY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[Secrets and Holograms|tenth episode]] of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' animated television series,<ref name="Secrets and Holograms">{{Resistance|Secrets and Holograms}}</ref> which aired on [[December 2]], [[2018]].<ref name="Air date">{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}}</ref>
